meta.title: Withdraw Intake Request: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role on the specified Growth tenant.
Open a pending-approval intake and use Withdraw Intake Request, observing whether Procol refuses or omits the action.
Repeat the same withdrawal as a Requester / End User and compare availability or success.
Verify or record the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
the plan has no assertion step — nothing the case checks can be observed
warnings: cannot test this case yet — the plan has no assertion step — nothing the case checks can be observed

args.need: sign in as both the user without the Requester / End User role and the Requester / End User, open an intake request with approvals pending, try Withdraw Intake Request for each user, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or succeeds

steps.note: The catalog cannot access intake requests, configure pending approvals, switch to these user roles, or observe the required RBAC outcome.
